title: Did my old job only exist because of fraud?
summary: A personal reflection and discussion exploring whether the author's previous employment was sustained primarily by fraudulent business practices, questioning the legitimacy of certain job roles in the modern economy.
problem_solved: Examines how fraud and deceptive practices can artificially sustain employment and entire job functions.
why_valuable: Provides a thought-provoking perspective on the relationship between business ethics, fraud, and employment sustainability in modern organizations.
